title: Noor Straight Kurti — Ink
description: A straight-cut kurti in matte ink crepe with clean three-quarter sleeves and a rounded neckline. Built to layer over trousers or a slip skirt without ever feeling fussy.

title: Amal A-Line Kurti — Sand
description: A softly flared A-line kurti in warm sand, with a curved hem and side slits for ease of movement through the day.

title: Zahra Embroidered Kurti — Gold
description: Hand-finished thread embroidery traces the neckline and cuffs of this gold-tone kurti. Subtle up close, striking from across the room.

title: Rima Angrakha Kurti — Blush
description: An angrakha-style wrap kurti in muted blush, with an asymmetric front tie and gently gathered sleeves.

title: Layla Everyday Kurti — Sage
description: Lightweight and breathable, built for daily wear. A quiet sage tone with side pockets, because pockets matter.

title: Meher Printed Kurti — Sand
description: A hand-block-print inspired kurti in a soft sand base, cut generously through the body with a straight hem.

title: Farah Kaftan Dress — Gold
description: A relaxed kaftan dress in a brushed-gold tone, with dropped shoulders and a self-tie waist. Equally at home at an evening gathering or over trousers on a quiet afternoon.

title: Sana Pleated Co-ord Set — Sand
description: A two-piece pleated set — a fluid tunic paired with matching wide-leg trousers — cut from the same bolt of fabric so the tones never fight each other.

title: Hana Modest Maxi Dress — Sage
description: A floor-length maxi in a soft sage crepe, with long sleeves and a modest neckline built into the pattern rather than added after.

title: Noor Tiered Skirt Set — Blush
description: A tiered maxi skirt with a cropped, high-neck blouse in a matching blush. Layered hems give it movement without adding weight.

title: Iman Wrap Dress — Ink
description: A wrap-front dress in matte ink crepe with a self-fabric belt, built to take you from desk to dinner without a costume change.

title: Reem Structured Tote — Camel
description: A structured top-handle tote in vegetable-tanned camel leather, roomy enough for a laptop and a day's essentials, with a detachable crossbody strap.

title: Dina Evening Clutch — Gold
description: A slim envelope clutch finished in a soft gold-tone leather, with a hidden magnetic clasp and a thin optional wrist strap.

title: Salma Crossbody — Black
description: A compact crossbody in smooth black leather with an adjustable strap and a single interior pocket sized for a phone and cards.

title: Yara Woven Tote — Sage
description: A hand-woven tote in a muted sage raffia blend with leather trim, built for warmer days and market mornings.

title: Mona Mini Crossbody — Blush
description: A petite crossbody in blush leather, sized for the essentials only — cards, keys, a lipstick — on a slim adjustable strap.
